family: VT-03 Round trip state → elements → state (ML-FR-003 AC2)
description: Angles at boundaries: Ω = 0, ω = π, ν just below 2π, i = π/2. Input state produced by L2c from the grid elements.
status: Committed before any engine run on it (tolerances.md §4.1 item 1). Not yet reviewed or approved; immutable once approved, corrections create a new version (plan §6).

constants.source: WGS 84 values as written in docs/architecture/proposed-architecture.md §3 (ML-TASK-011 dataset input; VT-19 primary-source status in docs/verification/l2-references-report.md)

model.constantsSource: WGS 84 values as written in docs/architecture/proposed-architecture.md §3 (ML-TASK-011 dataset input; VT-19 primary-source status in docs/verification/l2-references-report.md)
model.units: SI: m, m/s, s, rad, m³/s²
model.time: t_s / Δt: elapsed SI seconds from the epoch (contracts-v1.md §2)

producedBy.independence: Engine source (packages/astrodynamics) not read and engine not run (ADR-003); references import nothing from the engine.
producedBy.numberFormat: Every number is the shortest decimal that round-trips to the binary64 value (ECMA-262 Number::toString); JSON.parse restores the exact binary64. Signs of zero are not preserved (−0 written as 0).

method.roundTrip: L1: the expected round-trip state is the input state itself (exact).
method.referenceElements: In-plane polar formulation: h = r × v; i = atan2(√(h_x² + h_y²), h_z); Ω = atan2(h_x, −h_y); u = atan2(r·m̂, r·n̂) with n̂ = ẑ × h/|ẑ × h|, m̂ = ĥ × n̂; e cos ν = h²/(μr) − 1, e sin ν = h(r·v)/(μr); e = √(…); ν = atan2(e sin ν, e cos ν); ω = u − ν; a = 1/(2/r − v²/μ). atan2 only, no acos.

convention.rule: ADR-008 / architecture §3: circular (e < ε_e): ω := 0, ν := argument of latitude; equatorial (i < ε_i or π − i < ε_i): Ω := 0, ω := longitude of periapsis; both: Ω := 0, ω := 0, ν := true longitude. e and i are always the computed values.
convention.substituteAngles: OPEN CONVENTION (not fixed by any approved document; chosen by this reference, flagged for the Coordinator): substitute angles are measured from +x positively in the sense of motion, i.e. right-handed about the angular momentum ĥ. Prograde: ϖ = Ω + ω, λ = Ω + u (counter-clockwise seen from +z). Retrograde (i near π): ϖ = ω − Ω, λ = u − Ω (clockwise seen from +z). With this choice the regular element→state map with Ω = 0 (and ω = 0) reproduces the state of an exactly equatorial orbit, including i = π. When h_x = h_y = 0 exactly the node axis is +x.

referenceAccuracy.roundTrip: Exact (the input state; tolerances.md §7 VT-03 "Reference accuracy: L1").
referenceAccuracy.referenceElements: L2c extraction, validated by its own round trip within this tolerance (verification/src/ref/elements.test.ts). Informative for VI-03-type element comparisons.

tolerance.record: docs/verification/tolerances.md revision 3 (approved by the owner 2026-11-13) §7 VT-03
tolerance.measure: Euclidean norm of the difference between the round-trip state and the input state

elementRows.source: docs/verification/tolerances.md revision 3 (approved by the owner 2026-11-13) §8 VI-03(b) rows (two-sided, M = 4), at κ_h, e, sin i of the grid elements; null where the element is undefined or the row does not apply
